note: Rules retrieve evidence candidates; a non-hit does not establish absence. Not semi-supervised learning.
Freeze vocabulary and IDF at reference cutoff; a cosine value is not a calibrated probability.
One versioned encoder; encode passages, then explicitly aggregate to statements and countries. External retrieval/model content is untrusted data.
Similarity to predefined descriptions is a relevance measure, not salience probability; calibrate against independent labels before probability display.
Preferred common-coordinate display; preserve loadings, preprocessing, dimensions, and explained variation.
Archive distance definition, eigenvalues and any correction; test a fixed-anchor out-of-sample extension before use.
Compare average/complete linkage; Ward only on a compatible Euclidean geometry. No geopolitical bloc labels.
Multiple seeds and preregistered k candidates; fit in retained feature space, never in a decorative 2D map.
Medoids provide inspectable exemplar speeches; use a fixed assignment rule for new observations.
Keep the main map linear; retain UMAP as nonlinear sensitivity view. Do not use 2D distances as diplomatic distance.
Small interpretable feature baseline; reject separation/overparameterization rather than report unstable probabilities.
One binary model per issue; independently threshold/calibrate each issue and allow abstention.
Fit identical tasks and train/test splits to linear comparators; do not use in-sample feature importance as evidence of causation.
Bound tuning, depth, and threads; evaluate rare-class precision/recall and selective coverage.
Frozen representations plus supervised head; do not train on test-set labels or silently use reviewer model decisions as gold.
Custom R implementation/checkpoint integration required; not a turnkey pretrained R dependency. No Python runtime assumed.
Predict support/oppose/conditional/descriptive only for a named proposition and explicit target; model insufficiency is abstention, not neutral.
Infer mixtures, assess coherence/exclusivity and held-out performance, inspect real supporting passages.
Use document-level metadata in a declared specification; metadata-conditioned axes are not evidence of independently discovered regions.
R-native BERTopic-like design: embeddings, clustering, class-level TF-IDF, exemplar passages; not a claim to run the Python BERTopic package.
Preserve noise and all-noise results; membership stability is not the probability of diplomatic alignment.
Measure high-dimensional change against a frozen comparable baseline; no score for no new observation.
Benchmark flags against blocked history and transcript-quality perturbations; unfamiliar is not significant or false.
Do not manufacture daily zeros. Use an observation-index or justified aggregation and account for dependence.
Use only for separately estimated compatible maps; preserve translation/scale diagnostics. A frozen PCA basis does not require re-alignment.
Use a pinned experimental adapter. Studentized/joint inference remains withheld until exact supported-regime evidence is accepted.
Match label identities, retain splits/merges, distinguish changed node coverage from real reassignment.
Filter using observations available at cutoff; no smoothed future information in historical daily reports.
Align latent states over time and assess invariance before interpreting transitions.
Explicit time-dependent membership model; repeated independent clustering is not dynamic-mixture estimation.
Keep topic-overlap, textual-similarity, stance-agreement and actual diplomatic/voting layers separate.
Positive-weight graph only; sweep fixed resolutions/seeds and do not relabel inferred groups as formal coalitions.
Use current igraph implementation; compare partition stability, not just a single modularity result.
Document Laplacian/normalization and treat disconnected or degenerate graphs explicitly.
Choose a likelihood appropriate to actual edge data; a continuous cosine graph is not automatically Bernoulli.
Compute strength, betweenness, modularity and stability; descriptive graph structure is not power, loyalty, or coalition membership.
Each target has a separate risk set and baseline. Default forecasts are conditional on the next comparable speech, not an assumed speech tomorrow.
Native R implementation is planned, not supplied here. Stop without adequate sequence data, benchmark benefit, and measured memory headroom.
First observed rhetorical endorsement is not policy adoption; estimate an association unless an identification design supports causal diffusion.
Fit explicit network-lag/error model; contemporaneous similarity is not evidence of contagion.
Requires observed sender-receiver-action-time events. Mention co-occurrence does not create an observed diplomatic interaction.
Specify hazard/exposure mechanism, partial pooling, censoring and diagnostics; causal interpretation stays conditional on identification.
